observations: The page number «23» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L02 end chapter 30 (p. 22, JP2 0054, L25-L27). L03 and L11: the headings of chapters 30a and 31, in bold, centred; in the right margin beside the heading of chapter 31 «C 79v, O 136v», beside L12 «N 41v». L11: «elistima» and «elistikbel», the conjunction (al-ijtimāʿ) and the opposition (al-istiqbāl).

L01-L10: the apparent diameters. The sun: its daily motion times 33 minutes (p. 22, L27), or its hourly motion times thirteen and a fifth. Checked: 24 × 0;33 = 13;12, so the two rules agree, and 59′ 8″ × 0;33 gives 32½′. The moon: its daily motion times 0;2,16, or its hourly motion times 0;58,10; these do not agree, since 24 × 0;2,16 is 0;54,24; with the moon's daily motion of 13° 10′ 35″ the first gives 29′ 52″, the second, with the hourly 32′ 56″, 31′ 56″. To be compared with Suter's commentary on chapters 30 and 30a (p. 78).

L12-L23: the conjunction and the opposition from the tables: enter with the collected years, the single years and the month, adding days, hours and parts, the mean motions of the sun and the moon, the argument of the moon and the argument of latitude; the hours are counted from noon of the following day; the result is the mean conjunction or opposition, which is then refined (continued on p. 24).

N02: the dash before the note number 6 is printed in two pieces, 24 and 7 px long with a gap of 3 px; transcribed as one long dash. N07-N09: the marginal addition of C, with the editor's square brackets around the letters he supplies, «[No]ta», «[so]lis», «[lu]nae», «[sic]ut», and «[. . . .]es» for a gap. N11: «conjunctionem», with j, where the edition prints i in this word everywhere else (L12, N04, N13-N15); transcribed as printed. N04 and N06: «C O» and «O N», the sigla with a space between them.
The colons and semicolons of the text and the apparatus stand after the thin space of the edition (12-13 px measured in the text).
